description: This file defines an interface class `IAVBufferHelper` for managing memory buffers, including mapping, unmapping, and copying operations, intended for use in multimedia buffer handling within the project.

classes.name: IAVBufferHelper
classes.description: An interface class providing virtual methods for buffer management, including mapping, unmapping, size retrieval, secure writing, and copying of buffers using handles.

methods.name: mapHandle
methods.description: Maps memory from a given handle and returns a pointer to the mapped data, also outputs the size of the mapped data.

methods.name: unmapHandle
methods.description: Unmaps memory associated with a given handle. Returns true if successful.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the memory allocated to a specific handle.

methods.name: bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle,void * data,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Writes data into a secure buffer identified by a handle; default implementation returns false.

methods.name: bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo,uint64_t handleFrom,CopyMap map,uint32_t mapSize)
methods.description: Copies data between secure buffers specified by handles using a mapping; default implementation returns false.

ctags.name: copySecureHandleWithMap
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo, uint64_t handleFrom, CopyMap map, ui/

ctags.name: writeSecureHandle
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle, void* data, uint32_t size) { return false; }$/
